prompt: You could spend the next year working in one of these places. Which do you pick?
helper: Picture the actual building, not the job title.

options.label: A hospital ward or a clinic
A courtroom or a lawyer's chambers
An airport — the cockpit, the tower or the hangar
A hotel, a busy kitchen or an event venue

prompt: Which title would you be proudest to have on your card?
helper: The one you would want people to call you, not the one that pays most.

options.label: Engineer
Officer — in the army, the police or the civil service
Designer
Teacher

prompt: Pick the problem you would most like to spend your career on.
helper: Not the one that sounds most important — the one you would keep thinking about.

options.label: Enough food and water for a growing country
Children and families who never got a fair chance
Cities that need better homes, roads and public spaces
A disease that nobody has cured yet

prompt: A free Saturday. Which of these would you actually choose?
helper: What you would do, not what you think you should do.

options.label: Train, play or coach a sport
Put together an outfit or plan a look
Fix a machine, rewire something or work on an engine
Organise a trip or an event for friends and family

prompt: Which of these would you read about just because you want to?
helper: Think about what you already click on.

options.label: Markets, money and where it goes
New apps, AI and technology
Films, news and what people are talking about
Laws, politics and how the country is run

prompt: Which kind of responsibility would you want to carry?
helper: All of them are hard. Which weight would you choose?

options.label: Leading a team through a crisis or a mission
Keeping hundreds of people safe by following procedure exactly
Growing a company and winning customers
Making sure a building, a bridge or a plant never fails
